findings.desc: The REVIEW advisory injection ignores parallelGate.mode==='off'. resolveAuditConfig accepts 'off' as the reversible escape hatch (spec §4.7: mode off disables BOTH behaviors), but the injection only checks that parallelGateCfg exists, so story_review still appends decomposition_advisory issues when the gate is disabled. Fix: make decompositionAdvisoryIssues return [] when cfg.mode==='off' (keeps the gate mode-agnostic, puts the mode policy in the caller layer per §4.4); add a smoke assertion that mode:'off' yields no advisory issues even when the gate would return advisories.
findings.resolvedReason: decompositionAdvisoryIssues returns [] when cfg.mode==='off' (before the gate call); smoke asserts mode off yields no advisory issues. commit 43f92ab3f.

findings.desc: MAJOR: storyRef() calls store.readScopeContract for self + each peer with NO try/catch. readScopeContract returns null only for a MISSING contract and RE-THROWS (SyntaxError) for a corrupt/unparseable scope-contract.json. The flatMap only handles null, so a single corrupt contract anywhere (peers=allStories) crashes the entire parallel_wave_create command — a NEW crash surface (the wave never read contracts pre-S4). Sibling story-review.ts wraps the identical reads in try/catch. Fix: read all contracts once via a safe try/catch helper into a Map in createParallelWave, pass to storyRef; treat a throw as a missing contract.
findings.resolvedReason: safeReadScopeContract(store,id) try/catch->null added; createParallelWave builds contractsByStoryId Map once over allStories and threads it to storyRef which does pure Map lookups (no I/O, no throw); story-review reads switched to safeReadScopeContract too. Corrupt contract no longer crashes the wave. commit 43f92ab3f.

findings.desc: MAJOR: the smoke's adversarial 'does not throw' assertions exercise the pure helpers (computeScopeGlobOverlaps with omitted peers), NOT the real corrupt-peer crash site (storyRef's store.readScopeContract). They give false confidence that the corrupt-contract case is covered. Fix: extract an exported safeReadScopeContract(store, id) (try/catch -> null) used by createParallelWave, and assert in the smoke that a fake store whose readScopeContract THROWS yields null (no throw).
findings.resolvedReason: smoke asserts safeReadScopeContract against a store throwing SyntaxError->null, throwing Error->null, returning contract->passthrough, null->null — exercises the real crash site. commit 43f92ab3f.

findings.desc: MINOR: scopeGlobOverlapDegradations is always passed explicitOverrideNote ' Explicit parallelSafe=yes is overridden by collection-level safety.', but this advisory does NOT change the safety tier, so nothing is overridden. Misleading human-facing text. Fix: pass '' (or an advisory-appropriate note).
findings.resolvedReason: scopeGlobOverlapDegradations call in resolveWaveSafety now passes no override note (defaults '') since the advisory doesn't change the safety tier. commit 43f92ab3f.

findings.desc: MINOR: CHK-001 helpers tested in isolation; scopeGlobOverlapDegradations is fed a hand-written pairExample rather than computeScopeGlobOverlaps' actual output, so a separator change between the two helpers would not be caught. Fix: add one assertion composing scopeGlobOverlapDegradations(id, computeScopeGlobOverlaps(...)) and asserting the reason contains the composed pair string.
findings.resolvedReason: smoke adds an end-to-end composition assertion chaining computeScopeGlobOverlaps into scopeGlobOverlapDegradations and asserting the pairExample renders verbatim in the reason. commit 43f92ab3f.

findings.desc: MINOR: computeScopeGlobOverlaps guards self.parallelSafe==='yes' but not self's terminal phase — a DONE story still asserting parallelSafe=yes could emit live overlap advisories. Fix: add self.phase and skip when TERMINAL_PHASES.has(self.phase) (symmetry with the peer filter).
findings.resolvedReason: computeScopeGlobOverlaps self param gained phase:StoryPhase and returns [] when TERMINAL_PHASES.has(self.phase); storyRef passes canonical phase; smoke asserts terminal self yields []. commit 43f92ab3f.

findings.desc: mode='off' escape hatch incomplete: it only silences the story-review advisory, NOT the WAVE scope_glob_overlap degradation. Spec §4.7 'off disables both behaviors / reversible escape hatch' — an operator who disables the gate still sees scope_glob_overlap warnings in the wave projection. Codex host-2 MAJOR; Claude adjudicators refuted (config-independence of the projection). SYNTHESIS fix: keep resolveWaveSafety + computeScopeGlobOverlaps PURE (config-free); have the createParallelWave FACTORY (already impure, reads store+root) resolve parallelGate.mode once and pass scopeGlobEnabled=(mode!=='off') to storyRef, which skips computeScopeGlobOverlaps when disabled. + smoke.
findings.resolvedReason: createParallelWave resolves parallelGate.mode once and threads scopeGlobEnabled=(mode!=='off') into storyRef; storyRef computes scopeGlobOverlaps only when enabled, so mode='off' emits no wave scope_glob_overlap degradation. Config read confined to the factory; resolveWaveSafety + computeScopeGlobOverlaps stay pure (grep-verified). Smoke: advise/block enable -> overlaps; off -> []. commit 4612174fa.

findings.desc: MINOR: the safeReadScopeContract smoke proves the helper returns null on a throwing store, but does not exercise the createParallelWave -> contractsByStoryId -> storyRef end-to-end crash site. Fix: add a minimal end-to-end assertion (if feasible without heavy fakes) that createParallelWave completes when one story's readScopeContract throws, preserving readable peers; otherwise document that the helper-level coverage + source-verified usage is sufficient.
findings.resolvedReason: safeReadScopeContract helper tested (throw->null, both error kinds); a full hermetic createParallelWave e2e was judged disproportionate (its storyRef path runs buildCanonicalStory ~13 store reads + real git probes). Mitigation: createParallelWave routes EVERY contract read through safeReadScopeContract (contractsByStoryId build) and storyRef only does pure Map.get lookups — no direct store.readScopeContract in that path — so a corrupt contract cannot throw out of createParallelWave; documented with a source-cited smoke note + helper assertion. commit 4612174fa.
